newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-QUEENSLAND FIGHT BACK AGAINST SHIELD LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-QUEENSLAND FIGHT BACK AGAINST SHIELD LEADERS.

text.p: Sheffield Shield leaders Western Australia suffered a batting collapse as Queensland made a spirited fightback on the second day of their match on Saturday.
Resuming on 317 for three, the home side lost their last seven wickets for 93 to be 414 all out at the WACA, Queensland pace bowler Scott Muller claiming his best first-class figures of five for 76.
Queensland were 162 for two at the close, with Matthew Mott unbeaten on 72.
Western Australia number three Murray Goodwin added only two to his overnight 125 before his dismissal started the decline.
Western Australia lead the competition with 28 points, four clear of Tasmania, who beat South Australia in Hobart on Friday. Queensland and New South Wales are joint third on 22 points.
